name: Taketomi (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Taketomi town emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character of angular strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Taketomi, a town in Okinawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Taketomi town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character of angular strokes
